subject: empty village market stall seen from its customers' side: an open frame of four squared weathered oak posts with pegged corner braces, a plain counter of thick oak planks at waist height across its whole front over a boarded front panel, and above it a gently sloping awning of faded red and cream striped linen canvas stretched over a light timber frame, its front hem scalloped; nothing at all on the counter or under it
